title: The C4 model: context, containers, components and code

videos.script: A map of Brazil does not show the streets of Salvador. A street map of Salvador does not show Brazil. Nobody thinks either map is wrong. {{title}} The C4 model draws software the same way, at four zoom levels. {{zoom}} At the first level, Carcará's ticketing is one box. Around it are the people who use it and the systems it talks to. {{context}} Zoom in once, and the box opens into the things that run. Apps, an API, databases, a queue. {{containers}} Zoom in again, into one of them, and you see its main parts. {{components}} The fourth level is the code, and you will almost never draw it. {{code}} C4 is not a notation. It is a small set of words, used the same way every time. A person. A software system. A container. A component. Most of this lesson is about using those words strictly, because that is where the clarity comes from.
